def solve_problem():

    m = Model("Optimization_Problem")

    # 2. Variables
    vars = {}

    vars['Var_2'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=15.2, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_2')
    lin_expr += 1.92 * vars['Var_2']
    vars['Var_3'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=6.77, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_3')
    lin_expr += 5.77 * vars['Var_3']
    vars['Var_4'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=19.7, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_4')
    lin_expr += 8.76 * vars['Var_4']
    vars['Var_5'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=15.24, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_5')
    lin_expr += 4.31 * vars['Var_5']
    vars['Var_6'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=5.04, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_6')
    lin_expr += 3.22 * vars['Var_6']
    vars['Var_7'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=5.24, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_7')

    vars['Var_8'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=12.9, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_8')
    lin_expr += 9.55 * vars['Var_8']
    vars['Var_9'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=16.11, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_9')
    lin_expr += 2.39 * vars['Var_9']

    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MINIMIZE)

    m.addConstr(-1.16 * vars['Var_1'] + 7.44 * vars['Var_10'] + -2.89 * vars['Var_2'] + -5.7 * vars['Var_5'] >= 24.48, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(-9.54 * vars['Var_10'] + 9.1 * vars['Var_5'] + 2.31 * vars['Var_7'] + -5.71 * vars['Var_8'] >= -70.71, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(9.58 * vars['Var_2'] + 3.13 * vars['Var_7'] >= 44.1, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(-0.85 * vars['Var_1'] + 6.68 * vars['Var_10'] + 2.58 * vars['Var_2'] + 3.94 * vars['Var_8'] >= 102.06, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(-5.33 * vars['Var_10'] + 5.44 * vars['Var_3'] + -3.17 * vars['Var_4'] + -4.56 * vars['Var_6'] + -3.21 * vars['Var_8'] >= -103.97, name='C6')
    m.addConstr(-4.36 * vars['Var_2'] + -8.68 * vars['Var_4'] + -6.43 * vars['Var_5'] + 0.74 * vars['Var_9'] >= -131.06, name='C7')
